Prime perks are looking prettier than ever. Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days is the retailer’s fall shopping event, giving Prime members 48 hours of special savings across categories from beauty to tech. Get Prime to Enjoy the 2026 Amazon Prime Big Deal Days

Prime Big Deal Days is a membership-only event, so having an Amazon Prime subscription unlocks the deals on Oct. 6 and 7. In the U.S., Prime costs $14.99 monthly or $139 annually, while eligible new members can begin with a 30-day free tria l. The membership also brings everyday extras, including fast shipping, Prime Video, Amazon Music, Prime Reading and Amazon Photos storage. Eligible young adults and students can access a lower-cost Prime option after a six-month trial, paying $7.49 monthly or $69 annually. If you continue after a trial, your membership renews according to your selected plan unless you cancel today.

About r.e.m. beauty by Ariana Grande

Founded by Ariana Grande , r.e.m. beauty centers makeup around creativity, individuality and personal expression. The collection spans eyes, lips and complexion, with shades and formulas intended to work across different skin tones, textures and beauty preferences. Its products are made for simple everyday routines as well as more imaginative looks, giving shoppers room to experiment. The brand also emphasizes thoughtful, performance-focused formulas and multi-use products that fit easily into a modern makeup bag. Furthermore, every r.e.m. beauty formula is vegan, and the brand is cruelty-free, meaning it does not test its products on animals.

Meet the Author

Sophie Dunne  is an E-Commerce Writer at Penske Media Corporation, writing across Billboard, Rolling Stone, The Hollywood Reporter, WWD and Footwear News. Originally from Ireland and based in Los Angeles, she previously worked at Static Media as a writer and editor across all brands, covering entertainment, lifestyle, fashion, shopping, sex and relationships, travel, home and garden, tech, health and wellness, history, and food. Her bylines have appeared in Women’s Health, The List, Women.com, Islands, Grunge, WebMD, and more. Before beginning her writing career in 2019, Sophie lived in Dubai for four years working as an Emirates Cabin Crew Member. Having traveled to 71 countries with the airline, she began writing for an LA-based publication as a travel writer during her final year. Sophie has a degree in Humanities from Carlow College, St. Patrick’s (now South East Technological University) in her native Ireland. She studied English, history, philosophy, and psychology.
